title: Hanriette NDE 6033
content: I was admitted to the hospital to give birth to my first child. The labor was a difficult one for me as I suffered a uterine rupture and several small spills in my eyes and face. I lost a large amount of blood and after I finished giving birth, I was taken to a bed at the maternity ward. The next day, when I was showering, I fell on the bathroom floor. At that moment, I saw, like in an old movie going backwards, clear images of my life from being an adult to my childhood. I found myself in the middle of a grayish white mist and I noticed three beings dressed in white like angels, a woman to my left, a man in front of me and another man to my right. All of them had very dark hair. The woman had long hair to her shoulders and the men's hair was cut at the height of their ears. I couldn't see their faces because they were made of a very bright white light. They were communicating with me not through their mouths but by means of some kind of telepathy. When I woke up from my fall, a nurse was patting my face and trying to get me out of the bathroom. That was when I fell over again and I ended up at the same place surrounded by those three beings as before. I felt that we had talked for many hours although the perception of time is not the same as we perceive down here. I can't remember what we chatted about. All I remember was that I didn't want to come back and I begged not to be sent back. The being in front of me was telling me that I couldn't stay and had to go back. When I regained consciousness, the nurse was laying me down in my bed and I felt like being at home. Today I think that because I didn't want to come back, in spite of having a newborn baby daughter to take care of, that means for sure that we have a mission to accomplish here and then we'll be allowed to go back to God.

arrival.other_being_detail: Three beings dressed in white “like angels” (woman on left, man in front, man on right) with very dark hair; faces not visible because they were “made of a very bright white light.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Uterine rupture with large blood loss; collapsed/fell in hospital bathroom the next day after giving birth.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated collapse with return to the same place and beings.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life review occurred at the moment of falling; then mist with three angel-like beings and telepathic communication; return to body; then a second fall repeating the same realm/encounter; told to go back; return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Encounter with the three beings and the mist-like realm occurred again after a second fall.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Life review described “like in an old movie going backwards,” from adulthood to childhood; experience repeated after regaining consciousness and falling again.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “like in an old movie going backwards, clear images of my life from being an adult to my childhood.”; “I found myself in the middle of a grayish white mist”; “They were communicating with me not through their mouths but by means of some kind of telepathy.”; “I didn't want to come back and I begged not to be sent back.”; “the being in front of me was telling me that I couldn't stay and had to go back.”; “I felt like being at home.”
